title: The telegram, 27 August 1900
caption: The seven words of Bell's 'Unicode' message to Mabel, each set beside the phrase printed next to it in the 1896 phrase book (pages 88, 35, 96, 5, 95, 78). Bert is plain text; Promulgo is the book's value and is not explained by the letter.

tokens.p: Wrote to you by this morning's post
Am quite well, and writing by post
Weather very fine, sea quite smooth
